summary: `openCompletion({ trigger, query?, source? })` opens a completion list from code, e.g. a toolbar button: on `useChatComposer()`, `useChatComposerInput()` and the `RichMentionInput` handle. Closing the list untouched removes the inserted trigger again.
howTo: If your toolbar opens the `@` or `/` list by writing the trigger into the editor and dispatching a synthetic `new InputEvent('input')`, call `composer.openCompletion({ trigger: '@' })` from `useChatComposerInput()` (or `useChatComposer().openCompletion`, which waits until the composer is mounted) instead. It focuses the editor, adds a space when needed, searches at once without the debounce, and `source: 'people'` limits the list to those provider ids. Escape, an outside click, blur or an empty result remove the text again when the user typed nothing. A custom `RichMentionInputHandle` implementation may add the optional `openCompletion`.
